en._faq_a_printing: When you've filled all the shots on a film roll in a camera activity—or whenever you like—you can "send the film roll for development." This starts a countdown for the duration you choose (e.g. 8, 24, 36 hours), after which your photos are "developed" and become visible. When the time is up, your encrypted photos are unlocked and appear in your album.
en._faq_q_send_to_print: How do I send my photos for development?
en._faq_a_send_to_print: Tap the "Send for Development" button at the bottom of the camera activity. Then choose how soon you want your photos to be ready (e.g. 8, 12, 24, 36 hours). Keep in mind that shorter times (Express) may require watching a rewarded ad.
